name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses match the task. 'Take the key, then open the door' is captured by hard Existence(door_open) plus hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), which together also force the key pickup. 'After that, try to pick up the box' keeps the order hard via Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) while the cue 'try to' makes only the box pickup a soft Existence(target_picked_up); since that last step is only preferred, the hard Existence(door_open) is needed and not redundant. The empty Redundant list and the 'Every way to finish includes: has_door_key, door_open' clue are consistent with the task.
